en_how: depth.py estimates a depth map for a public-domain 1942 landscape with Depth Anything V2; a fragment shader works out where each pixel lands once the camera moves (near pixels shift more than far ones, iterated to fill occlusions), giving one still photo a push-in and orbit; the brand title lives on a layer between the sky and the peaks, rising from behind the mountains and clipped by the summits; midway a sweep reveals the depth map itself, and it ends on a fictional outdoor brand's end card.
